title: Cadence vs Calendly for recruiting teams
description: Calendly is a great general-purpose scheduler. Cadence is recruiting-native: no-show defense, candidate status pages, ATS write-back, and GDPR tooling.

faq.q: When is Calendly enough for recruiting?
faq.a: For simple one-to-one screens booked against a single calendar, a general-purpose scheduler works well. The gaps appear around panels, no-show recovery, candidate status, ATS write-back, and erasure duties.

faq.q: Does switching from Calendly disrupt candidates?
faq.a: No. Candidates never create an account with either tool; with Cadence they receive the same kind of booking link, plus a manage link and a private status page for the rest of the process.
